result.rationale: The spec does `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42` but routes.rb only defines `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` and `put "members" => "groups#add_members"`. A PUT to that path dispatches to add_members, whose `return can_not_modify_automatic if group.automatic` also yields 422 — so the assertion passes without ever executing remove_member's guard, exactly as the finding claims.

adjudication.rationale: In the spec, `xhr :put, :remove_member, ...` targets the `remove_member` controller action explicitly; in controller specs this bypasses routing, so it does not “hit add_members instead” due to the routes using DELETE for `/members`. The `remove_member` action itself also doesn’t branch on HTTP verb, so using PUT would still exercise the same automatic-group guard (`return can_not_modify_automatic if group.automatic`).
